HIGHEST PRIORITY GEOMETRY: Soyo's FACE must be STRAIGHT UPRIGHT and front-facing, facial centerline exactly vertical. The centers of BOTH EYES have the SAME Y coordinate on a HORIZONTAL line; cheeks at the same level. The supplied pilot has a diagonal face: do NOT copy that tilt. Curved hair or asymmetrical eyebrows do not rotate the facial plane. The complete cat BODY hangs VERTICALLY below the head; this is never a horizontal cat rotated ninety degrees.

Draw ONE new original transparent vertical edge companion of Nagasaki Soyo from MyGO!!!!! as a spare 2D cartoon HUMAN-LIKE HEAD integrated with a complete WHITE meme-cat body. The attached accepted Sakiko image is ONLY a family grammar reference for simple contours, flat white face, two-zone round eyes, body scale and the relationship of paws clasping a vertical side. Recreate Soyo's own recognisable head, not Sakiko recolored: LONG LIGHT-BROWN hair in a few broad soft groups, gently curved cheek locks and slightly curled tips, parted grouped fringe, clear BLUE irises. No gold eyes, blue-purple hair, Sakiko ribbons, invented bows or official 3D material. Long brown hair descends behind and along the left/outside shoulder, leaving the right paw-contact silhouette open. Minimal white-interior cat ears can rise behind the hair as anatomy of this project-original cat form. No human clothes, collar, uniform, skirt or socks.

The moment: she has been rereading a little shared story she quietly adjusted, leaving an overly neat excuse with one intentional gap. From her place beside its edge, she hears the familiar reader name exactly what that fictional character really wanted. She has been understood, and is pleased without surrendering all her teasing composure. The eyes remain round, level and awake toward the viewer, with a small knowing lift in one brow and the other nearly relaxed. Give a VERY SMALL CLOSED shallow curved mouth with just ONE corner slightly lifted, not a broad smile, not the pilot's w-shaped mouth, not Anon's exuberance. No sultry half-lids, mature lipstick or maternal gaze. Her upper paw is keeping her own place; the lower paw has softened its pressure, leaving room for the other person to continue. She is not offering a service and not sorting somebody's life. The story and reader are outside this sprite; do not draw book, text, speech bubble or props.

Keep the approved graphic family: white human-cartoon face and full white body, clean readable dark navy contours, simple round blue irises divided into just TWO FLAT COLOR ZONES, sparse light-brown hair forms with at most one restrained flat shadow zone. Same pen and simplicity everywhere; no detailed human portrait attached to a realistic animal. No fur, plush texture, fleshy skin, 3D, glass infant eyes, huge star glints, blush or mature makeup.

Paw/body support: whole torso on the LEFT of an imaginary vertical edge around 82 percent of canvas width. Edge itself is invisible. One front paw curls RIGHT beside lower cheek, another curls RIGHT beside upper belly; both tips contact the same near-vertical x coordinate. A clear bent hind leg from the lower rump ends in a lower paw bracing that same side. Every paw connects to its shoulder/leg; no extra limbs and no sideways loaf. Body curves gently downward. A complete white tail has a connected lower-rump root, descends and makes one soft down-left curve, uncut at the tip. Face and eyes remain horizontally readable. The few long hair groups remain distinguishable from white tail and paws.

Portrait composition with generous transparent clearance; all ears, head, long hair, paws, torso, hind leg and tail fully visible. No panel, edge line, ruler, ledge, rectangle, background, floor, outer glow, cast shadow or colored haze. Genuine RGBA transparency beyond the normal narrow antialiased contour. No UI, border, watermark or collage. This is a new individual illustration for later optional rigging, not a crop or copied official pose.
